# scm_dlp_data_pattern (Resource)

Manages an Enterprise DLP Data Pattern.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A custom weighted-regex data pattern for internal employee IDs.
resource "scm_dlp_data_pattern" "employee_id" {
  name        = "Custom-Employee-ID"
  description = "Detects internal employee ID format EMP-XXXXXX"
  type        = "custom"

  detection_config = {
    technique                   = "weighted_regex"
    supported_confidence_levels = ["low", "medium", "high"]
  }

  matching_rules = {
    proximity_distance = 50
    proximity_keywords = ["employee", "emp id"]
    regexes = [
      {
        regex  = "EMP-[0-9]{6}"
        weight = 10
      },
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `detection_config` (Attributes) Detection technique configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detection_config))
- `name` (String) The name of the data pattern.
- `type` (String) The type of data pattern: custom, predefined, or file_property.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the data pattern.
- `matching_rules` (Attributes) Matching rules for regex and weighted_regex techniques. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--matching_rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data pattern.
- `status` (String) The status of the data pattern.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `version` (Number) The version of the data pattern.

<a id="nestedatt--detection_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detection_config`

Required:

- `supported_confidence_levels` (List of String) Supported confidence levels (low, medium, high).
- `technique` (String) Detection technique (e.g. weighted_regex, regex, ml, etc.).


<a id="nestedatt--matching_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matching_rules`

Optional:

- `proximity_distance` (Number) Proximity distance for keywords (2 to 1000).
- `proximity_keywords` (List of String) List of proximity keywords.
- `regexes` (Attributes List) List of regex rules with weights. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--matching_rules--regexes))

<a id="nestedatt--matching_rules--regexes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `matching_rules.regexes`

Required:

- `regex` (String) Regular expression pattern.
- `weight` (Number) Weight for the regular expression match.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP data pattern by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_data_pattern.example <id>
```
